summary.business_type: B2B Sales Outsourcing / Lead Generation Agency
top_findings: Canonical URLs point to wrong domain (upsale.co.il instead of upsaleil.com)
No meta descriptions on any page
Zero JSON-LD structured data across entire site
Mobile hero image is PNG (2MB raw) instead of AVIF (~25KB)
quick_wins: Fix canonical URLs to point to upsaleil.com
Add meta descriptions to all pages
Convert mobile hero image from PNG to AVIF
Add noindex to /thank-you and remove from sitemap

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt properly configured with sitemap reference
HTTP→HTTPS 308 redirect working correctly
HSTS set to 2 years
Vercel edge with 150ms TTFB

findings.title: Canonical URLs point to wrong domain
findings.description: Every page on upsaleil.com has canonical tag pointing to upsale.co.il. Service subpages additionally canonical to the homepage instead of their own URL. This splits SEO signals between two domains.
findings.recommendation: Change root layout canonical base to 'https://upsaleil.com' and set self-referencing canonicals per page.

findings.title: /services/telemarketing returns 404
findings.description: The page /services/telemarketing exists in the codebase but returns a 404 (Vercel error page). It is also missing from the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Either create the page at the expected URL or set up a 301 redirect to /services/Telemeeting.

findings.title: /thank-you indexed and in sitemap
findings.description: The post-conversion /thank-you page is included in the sitemap and has no noindex meta tag, signaling Google to index a page with no SEO value.
findings.recommendation: Add <meta name='robots' content='noindex'> to /thank-you and remove it from sitemap.

findings.title: Sitemap has stale dates and uniform priorities
findings.description: All 16 sitemap URLs share identical lastmod (2025-10-06, 8+ months old), identical changefreq (weekly), and identical priority (0.7). Includes /thank-you; missing potential pages.
findings.recommendation: Generate dynamic sitemap with accurate lastmod dates. Set homepage priority 1.0, services 0.8, articles 0.6-0.7.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, and X-Frame-Options headers are all missing.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers in vercel.json or next.config.mjs headers() function.

findings.title: Missing hreflang tags
findings.description: No hreflang tags on any page for the Hebrew-language site.
findings.recommendation: Add hreflang='he' and x-default tags to all pages.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage has ~800-1000 words of unique content
FAQ section with 10 relevant questions
Articles provide substantive information on sales outsourcing topics
Contact form present on all pages

findings.title: No dedicated About page
findings.description: /about returns 404. The only company information is a ~100-word inline section on the homepage with no named founders, team credentials, or company history.
findings.recommendation: Create a dedicated /about page with founder names, team bios, company history, and physical address.

findings.title: No author credentials on articles
findings.description: All 11 article pages attribute content to 'Upsale Team' only. No named authors, LinkedIn profiles, or professional qualifications displayed.
findings.recommendation: Add named authors with bios and LinkedIn links to each article.

findings.title: Unsubstantiated claims
findings.description: Claims of '40+ small businesses increased sales' and '25% average increase in 3 months' are stated without any client testimonials, case studies, logos, or verifiable references.
findings.recommendation: Add client testimonials, named case studies, or verifiable statistics.

findings.title: No physical business address
findings.description: No physical address is listed anywhere on the site. Only contact methods are WhatsApp number and email. Israeli commercial websites are required to display a business address.
findings.recommendation: Add physical business address to contact section and footer.

findings.title: Very thin content on service article subpages
findings.description: /services/Telemeeting/article-1 has only ~180-220 words. Other article subpages have 400-500 words, below the threshold for competitive ranking.
findings.recommendation: Expand all article subpages to 600+ words minimum with unique, substantive content.

findings.title: Thin service pages
findings.description: /services/sales-outsourcing and /services/Telemeeting each have only 400-500 words with minimal heading depth (2 H2s each).
findings.recommendation: Add 300+ words of original detail to each service page with proper H2/H3 hierarchy.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Homepage title tag is well-crafted (58 chars)
H1 tags exist on all pages (though some pages have duplicates)
Internal linking structure connects main pages

findings.title: Missing meta descriptions on all pages
findings.description: No page has a correctly-sized meta description. They are either entirely missing or far exceed the 150-160 character limit (some reaching 200-300 chars).
findings.recommendation: Add unique 150-160 character meta descriptions to every page using Next.js metadata exports.

findings.title: Duplicate title tags across pages
findings.description: Homepage and /articles share identical title: 'Upsale | המומחים במכירות במיקור חוץ'. Multiple pages have 'Upsale | Upsale' double branding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure every page has a unique title. Use pattern 'Page Title | Upsale' not 'Page Title | Upsale | Upsale'.

findings.title: Homepage has 3 H1 tags
findings.description: The homepage uses 3 H1 elements: hero text, main headline, and 'Who we are?' section. Only one H1 per page is SEO best practice.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to a single H1. Change 'מי אנחנו?' and hero line to H2.

findings.title: Wrong OG tags on subpages
findings.description: Service pages and article subpages inherit homepage OG title, description, and image. Social sharing will display generic homepage info.
findings.recommendation: Set page-specific OG metadata in each page's generateMetadata export.

findings.title: Navigation uses buttons not links
findings.description: Nav items for About, Services, FAQ, Contact use <button> elements with scroll-to-section JS. On subpages where these sections don't exist, navigation breaks.
findings.recommendation: Replace with proper <a href> links to standalone pages, or implement conditional navigation.

findings.title: Over-length meta descriptions on article pages
findings.description: Article page meta descriptions range from 162-307 characters, all exceeding the 150-160 char display limit.
findings.recommendation: Trim all meta descriptions to 150-160 characters.

findings.title: Zero JSON-LD structured data
findings.description: No JSON-LD schema markup was found on any page. This means no rich snippets in SERPs, no knowledge graph entries, and reduced AI crawlability.
findings.recommendation: Implement Organization schema on all pages, LocalBusiness schema with address/phone, FAQ schema on homepage FAQ, Article schema on all 11 article pages, BreadcrumbList schema, and Service schema on service pages.

categories.name: Performance / Core Web Vitals
what_works: TTFB ~150ms (Vercel edge, excellent)
Static assets cached 1 year with immutable directive
Brotli compression active (81% reduction)
Self-hosted Hebrew-subsetted fonts (9KB WOFF2)
font-display: swap for fast text rendering
All images have explicit width/height (CLS prevention)
Responsive srcSet on all images

findings.title: Mobile hero image is PNG (2MB raw)
findings.description: The mobile hero image (hero-3.png) is served as PNG at 262KB @750w. An AVIF equivalent would be ~25KB — a 90% reduction. This is the LCP element on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Re-export hero-3 as AVIF and update the import in the Hero component.

findings.title: Large vendors JavaScript chunk (767KB)
findings.description: The vendors JS bundle is 767KB even though it loads async. Total JS payload is ~942KB — heavy for a content-focused site.
findings.recommendation: Audit vendor dependencies for tree-shaking. Consider dynamic imports for heavy libraries.

findings.title: Unused Google Fonts preconnects
findings.description: Preconnect hints for fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com are present but Rubik is self-hosted via Next.js — these connections are never used.
findings.recommendation: Remove the Google Fonts preconnect hints.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Clear business niche and service descriptions
FAQ content available for AI extraction

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: No llms.txt at the site root for AI crawler accessibility.
findings.recommendation: Create llms.txt with key site information and structure for AI crawlers.

findings.title: No structured data for AI citation
findings.description: Without JSON-LD schema, AI systems cannot reliably extract business information, services, FAQs, or article content for citation.
findings.recommendation: Implement full JSON-LD schema suite (see Schema category).

findings.title: Claims lack citations for AI verification
findings.description: Statistical claims ('40+ businesses', '25% increase') lack citations or linked evidence, making them unreliable for AI citation.
findings.recommendation: Add verifiable citations, case studies, or third-party references.

findings.title: Hebrew language limitation
findings.description: Hebrew content is underrepresented in AI training data compared to English, reducing citability for Hebrew-language queries.
findings.recommendation: Consider bilingual content strategy (Hebrew primary, English summaries) to increase AI visibility.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% alt text coverage with descriptive Hebrew text
12 of 15 images use modern AVIF format
Responsive srcSet on all images via Next.js Image
Proper preload hints with fetchPriority='high' on hero images

findings.title: Mobile hero image uses PNG format
findings.description: hero-3.png is the only PNG among 15 images. At matching resolutions, AVIF is 8-12x smaller. This directly impacts mobile LCP.
findings.recommendation: Convert hero-3.png to AVIF format.

findings.title: Two article images could be better compressed
findings.description: Two article hero images are 65-68KB at 1200w resolution. They could be compressed further or served at 828w max for article cards.
findings.recommendation: Apply stronger compression or reduce max resolution for article card images.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix canonical URLs — change from upsale.co.il to upsaleil.com
Fix 'Upsale | Upsale' double branding in title tags
Add meta descriptions to all pages
Restore or redirect /services/telemarketing
Convert mobile hero from PNG to AVIF
Add noindex to /thank-you and remove from sitemap
Fix duplicate title on /articles page

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Rebuild sitemap with accurate lastmod and differentiated priorities
Create dedicated About page with team credentials and address
Add JSON-LD structured data (Organization, FAQ, Article, BreadcrumbList, LocalBusiness)
Fix heading structure (3 H1s → 1 H1 on homepage)
Add page-specific OG tags for social sharing
Fix navigation to use proper links not scroll buttons
Replace Google Site Verification placeholder with real token

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand thin content pages to 600+ words minimum
Add client testimonials and named case studies
Add author credentials to all articles
Add physical business address
Add hreflang tags (he-IL, x-default)
Replace generic article-1/2/3 slugs with descriptive URLs
Add security headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google Search Console with real verification token
Reduce vendors JS bundle size
Create llms.txt for AI crawler access
Remove unused Google Fonts preconnects
Set up regular sitemap regeneration on deploy
Monitor Core Web Vitals via CrUX/GA4
Quarterly content audit and E-E-A-T review
